notes.title: Hotfix #2 Further Fixes and Balancing
notes.notes:
We're back again with some more fixes and new content. Including improved matchmaking, improved performance and [b]two brand new weapons![/b]


[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Performance & stability[/h3]

-	Further crash fixes
-	Improved performance in decal & lights positioning systems
-	Improved performance of animation systems 
-	Improved performance of (de)materialization effects system
-	Improved game startup loading times by about 20% on lower end machines
-	Fixed two performance issues where you could get major lag (spikes)

We are constantly working on improving performance by tweaking small changes like seen above, and will try to further improve the performance step by step rest assured.

[h3] Matchmaking[/h3]

 -	Improved matchmaking flow to better handle back-filling and team distribution

Keep in mind that with low player population it might still be hard to find a game. Because of this for the meantime we have set the matchmaking open to all, so you can also be queued into matches on other regions.

[h3]Animation[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where the animation rig wasn’t swapped when gender of selected character skin
        was changed causing incorrect proportions in animation.
-	Fixed an issue where melee and reload animations wouldn’t play on high latency.
-	Fixed an issue where the reload animations could play faster than expected.
-	Fixed third person hit flinching not working on characters when damaged.
-	Fixed an issue where weapon sway would be applied after landing a vault
-	Improved all aiming animations slightly
-	Improved sprint to slide transition

[h3]Audio[/h3]

-	Added audio to various UI elements (button hovers and clicks, slider changes, toggle changes etc)
-	Added audio to progression screen at the end of the game
-	Added intense background music to signify the nearing end of the game
-	Fixed an issue with player footsteps not being the correct surface type

[h3]Party[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where the party invite would fail after a crash or alt+f4’ing the game

[h3]Visuals[/h3]

-	Reflex sight visibility & clarity improved

[h3]Settings menu[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where pressing “esc” during the rebinding process closed the whole settings menu
-	Fixed an issue where the resolution was unreasonably small on first startup

[h3]Wardrobe[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where the character skin list would snap to a random location when initialized
-	Fixed an issue where you could equip a weapon with the “change skin” input


[h3]Quick Access Bar[/h3]

-	Increased the scroll sensitivity on the quick access bar (e.g. friends list)

[h3]Skin Shop
[/h3]
-	Fixed an issue where you could get stuck when pressing esc immediately after buying a skin

[h3]Currency Shop[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where pricing was showing the incorrect currency symbol while the price was localized
-	Fixed an issue where ended transactions would still show a dark screen over the game


[h2]TWO NEW WEAPONS[/h2]

[h3]The Windsong[/h3]

Crafted from sacred hazel wood and tipped with razor-sharp obsidian, the Windsong is a very versatile weapon. Light and precise, it can get Contenders out of any close combat situation or hit enemies from afar with a single, precise throw, piercing armor and inflicting grievous wounds. In the hands of a skilled warrior the Windsong will tip the scales of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/26f8857526927eb3d1c7c62bab36d64930d17af1.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Matchstick[/h3]

Ignite the battlefield with The Matchstick, ΣRA's latest incendiary weapon, an advanced firearm designed to deliver maximum impact. Charge the weapon to unleash a devastating torrent of incendiary pellets, engulfing your enemies in flames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/4b235f755ce7712e792262f2ad347cacb98c54b4.jpg[/img]

Thank you for feedback and see you again soon!

The StickyLock Team

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Initial Fixes and Balancing
notes.notes:
Thank you for joining us for the release of Histera! The first hotfix has just been released and includes fixes and weapon balancing changes based on your initial feedback.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Crash fix[/h3]

We’ve applied a fix for one of the more prominent crashes relating to the glitch during gameplay.

[h3]HE Grenade[/h3]

The HE Grenade is now correctly thrown instead of dropped directly at your feet.

[h3]Profile Progression[/h3]

Tiers have been reset and adjusted to reflect the difficulty of the progression steps.

[h3]Performance & Stability[/h3]

Our current focus lies on stability fixes and performance improvements, the latter of which will be rolled out in small steps over the coming weeks. At the same time we are experimenting with smaller changes that might yield improvements to stability even more quickly. We'll keep you updated! 


[h2]Weapon Changes[/h2]

We've made several balance changes based on your initial reception and feedback. Let us know how the weapons feel after these changes!

[h3]Hunting Bow[/h3]
[list]
[*]Headshot damage multiplier adjusted from 1.5 to 1.7
[*]Projectile size reduced from 0.3 to 0.275
[*]Charge damage multiplier adjusted from 3 to 2
[*]Removed unintended slow
[/list]
[h3]Karabiner 43[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced screenshake intensity
[*]Reduced ADS sway
[*]Reduced recoil buildup
[/list]
[h3]AR-77[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced ADS sway
[*]Adjusted ADS sway radius
[*]Aim punch speed increased
[*]Damage decreased from 18 to 16
[*]Accuracy adjusted
[*]Bullet spread toned down
[/list]
[h3]Cyclone S6[/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage decreased from 12 to 11
[*]Hipfire accuracy improved
[*]Accuracy adjusted
[*]Bullet spread toned down
[/list]
[h3]Stormbringer T-2000[/h3]
[list]
[*]Base damage increased from 20 to 40
[*]Charge damage multiplier reduced from 6 to 2.5
[*]Electricity status effect removed
[/list]

Thank you for feedback and see you again soon!

The StickyLock Team

notes.title: Histera - New Release Date
notes.notes:
[h2]We're back and with a new Early Access release date
[/h2]

Get ready to enter the time glitching arena and dominate the battlefield like never before on [b]June 20[/b]. Wield weapons from various Eras, use powerful pick-ups, and fight intense battles through time!

[previewyoutube=-IJrOmSeJKw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Early Access Launch and why[/h3]
Early Access, kicking off the 20th of June, is our chance to connect with the community and gather valuable feedback to enhance Histera from its early development stages, to full release and beyond. We want to collaborate with players to refine and polish Histera into the ultimate FPS experience.
[h3]How long will the game be in early access? [/h3]
Taking community feedback and the time to implement suggested changes into account, we anticipate releasing Histera approximately 6 to 12 months after our Early Access launch. 
[h3]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h3]
Histera is a free-to-play game, with a basic monetization system introduced at the start of Early Access, expanding gradually during this period and focusing solely on optional cosmetic items.

[h2]What content will there be at early access launch?[/h2]
At launch we will share with you the exact roadmap of everything that is to come, but from the start players can expect the following:  

[h3]The Eras inside the arena[/h3]
The first Eras to be included in Histera are the futuristic Montorro City, the prehistoric Pliocene Plateau and the war-torn mid-20th century Novgorod. With the Glitch, these different eras can merge, posing both possibilities and challenges for players. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rB0gZEX.gif[/img]


[h3]The weapons inside the arena[/h3]
You don't want to find yourself empty-handed inside the arena of Histera. Luckily there is a big arsenal of weapons from the various Eras available for you to arm yourself with. These weapons offer variation in your gameplay and give you plenty of playstyles to work with. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/nwXG6Nu.gif[/img]


[h3]Pick-ups inside the arena[/h3]
Are the weapons not giving you enough kick? Or are you getting hit too hard? The pick-ups are here to help with that, and make sure you stay on top. Whether it’s a Glitch pickup that boosts your health or damage, or a shield pick-up to ensure you stay in the battle


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M9sNJlC.gif[/img]



[h3]Thank you [/h3]

We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone in our amazing community for the incredible support leading up to the launch of Histera. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and dedication have been invaluable on this journey.

To show our gratitude and to thank you for being an early adopter, we will be giving everyone that participates in the first two weeks of launch an exclusive skin for the AR-77, and everyone that participates at any point in early access a free exclusive skin for the Stormbringer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/9df122f7af5a15f322146dc12ce85f0b12feba4c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/8db77cf102f58abc50367d4785f147890c6960e3.png[/img]

We want to thank everyone for their patience the past month and we can't wait to see what the future brings. This is an exciting and scary moment for everyone at StickyLock, and we’re so happy to have made it this far. 

With release around the corner be sure to keep an eye out on our Steam and Discord, as well as our Twitter and Reddit, since we’ll be releasing information and content more and more frequently as we lead up to launch and after!
 
See you in the dome, 

StickyLock

notes.title: Histera's delay || UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h2]To all Contenders,[/h2]

First of all we want to extend an extra heartfelt apology for the delay of Histera's launch two weeks ago. We know many of you were eagerly counting down the days, and we apologise for any inconvenience or disappointment this may have caused. Your enthusiasm means the world to us, and we are committed to making this right and giving you the experience you desire and deserve.

[h3]Why the delay?[/h3]
Unfortunately,  we ran into performance issues that affected key aspects of the game. The impact didn’t surface until closer to launch. All though we worked 24/7 to try and solve issues, we couldn’t address them properly in the short time frame that we had. Fixing these issues is our top priority and we are thankful that Unity jumped in to help us.

[h3]Progression of the Development[/h3]
Besides fixing these issues, a portion of the team is continuing the development of the game to perfect the experience even more. More content post Early Access Launch is being worked on such as; new features, game modes, and skins. Rest assured, your wait will be worthwhile! 

[h3]Free Weapon Skins![/h3]
As a token of our gratitude for your continued support and patience, we will be offering two exclusive weapon skins for free to all players that log in during the first week. We hope these skins will enhance your gameplay experience and serve as an apology for any inconvenience we may have caused.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/56561dcca782fb6adfb0b36f1e3b304f2fa85af3.png[/img]

[h3]Things to do while you wait[/h3]
We understand that the wait can feel long so here’s some things you can do in the meantime

•	Get a playlist ready for your high-octane Histera matches
•	Warm up in aim trainer
•	Go for a hike or a walk in nature. Before you’re stuck inside for 2 weeks straight
•	Make sure you do your laundry

[h3]More Info Soon [/h3]
We will provide an updated launch date as soon as possible. Please stay tuned for further announcements and updates. Thank you for standing by us as we strive to perfect Histera.


See you in the dome,

StickyLock
